title: Gymnopedie No. 1 — explicit top voice, complete source form
reviewOutcome: Confident full written top-voice ledger. Not certified as a complete monophonic MIDI extraction: the voice has ending chords, and the official MIDI does not realize the source's complete repeat form.

voiceEvidence.scorePlacement: \top and \middle appear together on Staff = treble; \bottom appears on Staff = bass.
voiceEvidence.method: Transcribe the explicit top expression, not a MIDI track or a highest-note selection. Top has stemUp/slurUp; middle is separately authored accompaniment. MIDI combines top and middle on track 1/channel 0, so track identity is not voice identity.
voiceEvidence.key: \key b \minor (two-sharp signature, not an asserted tonal interpretation)

encoding.pairs: [MIDI, quarter duration]; null for rest OR source skip, distinguished by events.kind; an array of MIDI pitches is an explicit chord, not an unresolved pitch.
encoding.midiConvention: C4=60. Pitches follow relative notation, explicit accidentals and octave marks. Chord pitch arrays preserve source order.
encoding.durationUnit: Quarter note; dotted half=3, half=2, quarter=1. Each bar totals exactly 3.
encoding.tiePolicy: All written note segments retained with tieIn/tieOut. Slurs are not ties. For sounding output merge only tie-connected same-pitch segments; do not merge repeated attacks.
encoding.sourceLocations: 1-based lines in exact retrieved LilyPond text; IDs B1-B31/E1-1-E1-8/E2-1-E2-8 avoid misleading flattened bar numbers.

form.sourceComment: The original does not use a volta; changing volta to unfolded in each voice reproduces the original layout.
form.discrepancy: Official MIDI contains both alternatives but no second common-body pass; it is 31 bars/93 quarters shorter than the source-implied performance.
form.start: Four complete top-voice bars of printed multimeasure-type rests, followed by a one-quarter invisible skip in B5. First melody attack at quarter 13, tick 4992.
form.secondEntry: B13 begins with another invisible quarter skip; preserve it separately from printed rests.
form.end: Second ending includes the full C-major voicing [72,69,64,60] then D-minor voicing [74,69,65,62], each held 3 quarters, followed by final barline.

validation.matchingMethod: Every scalar/chord notehead segment outside B9-B12 was checked at its source-derived onset and duration against a covering track-1 MIDI event. Tied continuations were allowed to fall inside a sustained event. No highest-pitch selection was used.
validation.excludedReason: The four tied F#4 segments B9-B12 collide with accompaniment F#4 on the same track/channel; documented separately.

uncertainties.finding: The explicit top voice is polyphonic in the final two bars of both alternatives. There is no separately encoded scalar melody voice inside those chords. Selecting C5/D5, the highest pitch, or another chord member would be an editorial arrangement, not literal source extraction. No selection made.
Byte-identical official MIDI has only 47 bars, not the 78-bar source performance. It cannot be certified as full-form merely by matching the official download.

B9-B12 source holds F#4 for 12 quarters while accompaniment also strikes F#4 on the same MIDI track/channel. Observed MIDI contains F#4 on/off segments at tick 9216-9600, 9600-10752, 10752-11904, 11904-13056 and 13056-13824 instead of a clean top-voice 9216-13824 sustained note. This is a merged-voice MIDI note-event ambiguity; use source tie evidence, not highest-note filtering or raw note duration.
B5 and B13 use s4, not r4. Ledger records one quarter of top-voice silence with kind skip and printedRest false; this is not a guessed or padded rest.
Mutopia expressly compresses the original layout using volta alternatives. Review certifies the retrieved notation edition, not an independently inspected Dover facsimile.
